justification: Inspected android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/history/HistoryActivity.java, DBHelper.java, HistoryItemAdapter.java, HistoryManager.java, and HistoryItem.java. The package has clear fan-in: HistoryManager is imported by android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/CaptureActivity.java and five classes under android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/result/supplement/; HistoryActivity and HistoryItem are only used by CaptureActivity. Its outgoing dependencies are mostly to Android framework classes and widely reused ZXing/core app types (Result, BarcodeFormat, Intents, PreferencesActivity, ResultHandler), so there is no evidence that the package depends heavily on less-stable, low-fan-in packages.
